description: This PHP source file defines the ViewAjaxUI class, extending SugarView, which manages the display of an AJAX-based user interface component in the SuiteCRM application. It sets display options in the constructor and implements a display method that handles HTTP headers and UI rendering logic.

classes.name: ViewAjaxUI
classes.description: A class extending SugarView to render an AJAX-based UI component, with configurable display options and a display method that manages HTTP headers and UI rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor setting display options for the view, such as showing title, header, footer, JavaScript, and search options, then calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Method that generates an ETag header based on the current user's ID and seed, and prevents double rendering of the footer by modifying global state.
